subject.title: [Bug]: Bootstrap files in agentDir are silently ignored — only workspace directory files are injected into system prompt

question: Should a configured per-agent agentDir become an additional trusted bootstrap prompt source, or should OpenClaw preserve workspace-only bootstrap loading and warn when bootstrap-named files are placed in agentDir?
rationale: The code change is small, but the decision changes which directory can inject system-prompt content and how users recover from misplaced security instructions.

options.title: Preserve workspace-only loading and warn
options.body: Land a warning, doctor, and docs repair so users see that agentDir bootstrap files are not injected and can move them to the workspace.

options.title: Approve explicit agentDir loading
options.body: Treat configured agentDir as a trusted prompt source and require tests/proof for override order, filters, setup docs, and upgrade behavior before merge.

options.title: Pause until a broader design
options.body: Keep the issue open and hold the competing PRs until maintainers define the per-agent prompt-source model.

recommendation.title: Preserve workspace-only loading and warn
recommendation.body: Land a warning, doctor, and docs repair so users see that agentDir bootstrap files are not injected and can move them to the workspace.

likelyOwner.reason: The central bootstrap resolver history points most strongly to steipete, and the decision sits at that resolver's security/product boundary.
